concerns.text: Plan Phase 3 commits to three analyses with NO matching task: item 5 'A sensitivity analysis will also be run using alternative cut-offs (e.g., ROR > 1.5, PRR > 1.2)', item 9 'Minimum-detectable-effect analysis shows that with ≥5 reports the ROR confidence interval width is ≤ 0.5', and item 10 'Optional stratified disproportionality analyses by age group and sex... reported in supplemental tables'. No task in T001–T012 implements any of these; either add tasks or the plan must be trimmed so implementers know these are out of scope.

The plan's project structure lists dedicated contract tests 'tests/contract/test_dataset_schema.py' and 'tests/contract/test_signal_schema.py' plus 'tests/unit/test_memory_profile.py' and 'tests/unit/test_bh_monotonic.py'; no task creates these files. T010's validate_outputs.py covers the schema checks and T006/T009 cover BH/memory assertions in other files, but the plan's named test artifacts have no owning task — an implementer following the plan will produce orphan files or skip them with no verification.
